newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch -- March 5.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch -- March 5.

text.p: * Read-Rite Corp stood at 31-3/4 in after-hours trading Tuesday, down one point from its closing price. Applied Magnetics Corp reaffirmed its commitment to its takeover bid for Read-Rite.
* Micron Electronics Inc said it had formed a strategic alliance with 3Com Corp. The companies will develop network-ready products. Micron closed at 20. 3Com finished at 33-13/16.
* Corporate Express Inc said Wednesday its fourth quarter earnings will be below analysts' estimates, and 1996 earnings per share before expenses will be $0.05 to $0.07 below First Call estimates.
Wall Street had been expecting earnings of $0.16 per share for the fourth quarter and $0.50 for the year, according to First Call.
